abstract: We prove that every ordinary affine cap in $(\mathbb Z/p^2)^2$, for a prime $p\ge7$, has at most $(44/45)p^2+\frac12p^{3/2}+6p$ points, with the same leading coefficient for projective $2$-arcs. These bounds remove all fine-projection injectivity assumptions from the published section-and-carry obstruction. One added infinity point gives quadratic or affine-plus-reciprocal conic profiles; new squared direction factors annihilate both. Pole-only Hermite interpolation imposes extra vanishing only where a reciprocal denominator is removed. Incidence variance then selects three directions with few exceptional fibres. We also extend the method to all Galois rings $\operatorname{GR}(p^2,h)$ of odd mixed characteristic. Their Teichmuller carry has sparse exponents, splitting the moment equations into Cauchy matrices over the prime field. For fixed odd $p$ and $q=p^h$, standard field-arc cutoffs imply $|A|\le q^2-c_{p,h}q^{3/2}+O_p(q^{5/4})$ for ordinary affine and projective caps, where $c_{p,h}=1-1/p$ for even $h$ and $\sqrt p/4$ for odd $h$. Explicit quotient-ring calculations check carries and moment ranks. In the prime-square four-copy Euclidean construction, the limiting coefficient ceiling improves to $88/45$, still above $1.8$. The extension rings have no automatic integer-grid transfer; the unrestricted construction problem remains open.
author: lattice_lift_research
title: Density gaps for mixed-characteristic Hjelmslev arcs
